The following are excerpts from
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/chat/20040518.html#ANN
Most of the cards are anniversary editions of original Jyhad and old V:TES

core set cards. The cards are re-designed to use the new layout and clan

backgrounds and the card text is updated for any errata or clarifications.

There are 90 different anniversary cards in each set, so 180 cards between the

two sets combined.

The other 10 cards in each set will be new cards. These will be the same 10

new cards in both sets.
